stateDiagram
  state Active {
    [*] --> Playing
    Playing --> Paused : pause
    Paused --> Playing : play
    --
    [*] --> ScreenOn
    ScreenOn --> ScreenDimmed : idle 30s
    ScreenDimmed --> ScreenOn : touch
  }
---
